# Skill Samurai

> A world-class coding and STEM academy delivering curriculum-aligned education for kids aged 4-16 across Australian locations.

Skill Samurai offers comprehensive coding, robotics, and STEM programs including their proprietary MathCode™ Mastery Method, with flexible delivery through in-center classes, school incursions, holiday camps, and corporate programs. The academy serves students across multiple Australian locations and provides pathways to cloud computing certifications from major tech companies.

## Key Topics

- STEM education
- Kids coding
- Robotics
- Python programming
- Roblox game development
- Scratch visual programming
- MathCode™ curriculum
- School holiday camps
- Problem-solving
- AI and machine learning
- 3D printing
- Personalized learning
- School incursions
- Career certifications
- Sydney locations

## Core Programs & Classes

- [Skill Samurai | Coding and STEM Academy](https://skillsamurai.com.au): Skill Samurai homepage: coding, math, and STEM classes for kids aged 6-16
- [Skill Samurai Curriculum - The Way of the Hero](https://skillsamurai.com.au/coding-for-kids): World-class coding and STEM curriculum: Scratch, Python, Roblox, AI, 3D printing
- [MathCode™ Mastery Method - Maths Tutoring Supercharged](https://skillsamurai.com.au/mathcode): MathCode™ Mastery Method: curriculum-aligned maths with programming integration
- [School Readiness Programs](https://skillsamurai.com.au/school-readiness-programs): School readiness robotics and coding for ages 4-5: problem-solving and STEM
- [Free Kids Coding Class | Skill Samurai](https://skillsamurai.com.au/free-trial-class): Free trial coding class for kids ages 8-14 across multiple locations
